response.basis: Derived from numbered NL segments NL1-NL8 describing the microwave DoorShut/DoorOpen/DoorOpenWithItem/DoorShutWithItem/ReadytoCook/Cooking state machine. Author-source (PlantUML/canonical IR) used only for locus naming context, not for deciding satisfaction.

binding_hints.reason: The enclosing scope owning the initial edge is the whole microwave system.
DoorShut is the state entered by the initial edge.

contracts.normative_statement: The microwave system must have an initial entry edge into the DoorShut state at the root/system scope.
contracts.quote: The microwave starts in the DoorShut state.
contracts.reason: Explicit 'starts in' establishes an initial pseudostate edge to DoorShut.

contracts.basis: NL1 'remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed'

binding_hints.reason: DoorShut is both origin and destination of this retention transition.
Self-loop target is DoorShut itself.
Names the exact self-transition on Cancel.

contracts.normative_statement: On a Cancel action in DoorShut, the system must remain in (return to) the DoorShut state.
contracts.quote: the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
contracts.reason: NL1 explicitly states DoorShut is retained under Cancel, an independently violable self-loop endpoint.

contracts.basis: NL1 'transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened'

binding_hints.reason: DoorShut is the origin state named at the start of NL1's sentence.
DoorOpen is the explicit destination.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorShut, the system must transition to DoorOpen when the door is opened.
contracts.quote: or transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint stated as second alternative in the coordinated NL1 sentence.

binding_hints.reason: DoorOpen is the state from which the door-close action returns.
DoorShut is the explicit return destination.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorOpen, the system must transition back to DoorShut when the door is closed.
contracts.quote: The door can be closed to return to the DoorShut state.
contracts.reason: NL2 explicitly establishes the reverse endpoint from DoorOpen to DoorShut, distinct from the earlier DoorShut-to-DoorOpen transition restated in NL2's first sentence.

binding_hints.reason: DoorOpen is the state named as the current scope in NL3.
Explicit destination named.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorOpen, placing an item must transition the system to DoorOpenWithItem.
contracts.quote: placing an item inside the microwave transitions the system to DoorOpenWithItem
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint from DoorOpen triggered by placing an item.

binding_hints.reason: DoorOpenWithItem is the state from which removal returns.
Explicit return destination.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorOpenWithItem, removing the item must transition the system back to DoorOpen.
contracts.quote: If the item is removed, the system returns to DoorOpen.
contracts.reason: Explicit reverse endpoint triggered by item removal.

binding_hints.reason: Explicit source named at the start of NL4.
Explicit destination for the first alternative.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorOpenWithItem, the system must transition to DoorShutWithItem when the door is closed with zero time set.
contracts.quote: the system can transition to DoorShutWithItem if the door is closed with zero time set
contracts.reason: First alternative endpoint from DoorOpenWithItem with its own event/guard preserved in the transition group.

binding_hints.reason: Shared source with the first alternative.

contracts.normative_statement: From DoorOpenWithItem, the system must transition to ReadytoCook when cooking time is entered.
contracts.quote: or to ReadytoCook if cooking time is entered
contracts.reason: Second alternative endpoint from DoorOpenWithItem, distinct target from the first alternative.

binding_hints.reason: Shared source of both alternatives requiring disjointness.

contracts.normative_statement: The two alternatives from DoorOpenWithItem (door-closed-with-zero-time vs cooking-time-entered) must be mutually exclusive/distinguishable.
contracts.quote: to DoorShutWithItem if the door is closed with zero time set or to ReadytoCook if cooking time is entered
contracts.reason: Two coordinated alternatives sharing source DoorOpenWithItem with distinct conditions require distinguishability to avoid nondeterminism.

binding_hints.reason: Explicit source named in NL5.

binding_hints.reason: Shared source with the first alternative.
